content: Chaypitaga ricapurü chay Achrcashnuysi cayagtam galayunan cërasha paquigta. Jinarcurmi mayarü jucta chay chruscu angelnuysi cayagcunapita räyunuysi “Shamuy” nigta.
Niptinga rircärirmi ricapurü, juc yurag caballuta. Nätan logarayagninmi charayänag arcuta flëchantinta. Jinarcurmi paytaga gorärin juc corönata. Chaura payga yargorun yaligmi, jinaman yalinanpagmi.
Nä guepacag cërashata quichraruptinga mayarü, chay chruscu angelnuysi cayagpitam juctatag “Shamuy” nigta.

Chaura rircäriptïga yargaramun juc puca caballutan. Chay logarayagtaga nirun munayniyog cananpagmi, nätan cay pachachru runacunata mana alipa cawachinanpagmi, jinaman runacunata quiquincama wanuchinacuyagta cawachinanpagmi. Jinarcurmi goyurun juc alisca jatun espädata.

Nä mas guepacag cërashata paquiruptinga mayarü, chay chruscu angelnuysi cayagpita jucnintatan “Shamuy” nigta. Chaura rircarirga ricapurü yana caballutam. Nätan chay caballuta logarayagga charayänag balanzatam.

Chauraga mayarü chay chruscu angelnuysi cayagcunapa chraupinpitam cay nimugta: “Juclay kïlu trïgulam juc junagchru gänana golguepag canga. Jinaman quima kïlu cebädalam juc junagchru gänana golguepag canga. Nätan aceitiga, jinaman vïnuga pachalan cachun” nimugta.
Nä mas guepacag cërashata paquiruptinga mayarü, chay chruscu angelnuysi cayagcunapita ushanancagtam “Shamuy” nigta.

Chaura rircarinäpagga cayänag juc runtush caballum. Nätan chay logaragninpam jutin canag ‘Wanuy’. Chaypa guepanta gatirämugga canag wanuymi. Chayga aywamunag wanushacuna cacunanpitam. Chaytam cay nirun: “Cay pachachru runacunata, lamitäpita mas lamitänincagta wanuchiy, espädawan, micuypita, gueshyawan, jinaman sima uywacunawan” nirun.

Chaynuytan nä mas guepacag cërashata paquiruptinsi altar chraquinchrüga ricapurütag unay wanushacunata. Paycunaga Diospa willapanta willapacurcanganpitam, jinaman chay willapacurcangannuy ali cawapäcunganpitam wanuchisha capäcura.

Paycunapa almancunam gayachracuypanuy cay nipäcunag: “Japalay Munayniyog Dios, lapan juchapita caruchru cacug, rimangaynuy rurag, ¿Imaytag wac wanuchipäcamagcunapa juchancunata taripanqui, jinaman wac pachachru yachrarcayagcunata cunchuchinqui?” nipäcunag.
Nipäcuptinga gorun yurag jacucunatam. Chaypitam cay nirun: “Uchuclataga masrag shuyayäriy. Gamcunatanuysi willapacug-mayiquicunata wanuchiyta aypachipäcungancama” nirun.
Nä sogtacag cërashata paquiruptinga rircärïmi. Jinarcurmi pacha cuyuyta galacuyun alicusa. Chauraga intim muyurun yanaman juc lütu jacumannuy. Nätan quillam muyurun yawarmannuy.
Jinaman goyllarcunam jana pachapita ishquirärimun cay pachaman. Walyaptin hïgos montipa mishquincuna ishquimugnuy.
Chaura cieluga garapita juc röllu wancucagnuymi illacarun. Nätan lapan jircacunas, tishgocunas chay cuyuyaptilanmi ashurärin jucläman.

Jinarcurmi cay pachachru mana cäsucugcunaga, reycunas, aliscannin wiragochacunas, capogniyogcunas, soldäducunapa mandagnincunas, munayniyogcunas, rantisha runacunas, mana rantisha runacunas, lapan pacacarärin machraycunaman, jircacunachru gagacunaman
cay nirayar: “Ishquimuy nogacunaman gagacuna, jircacuna, nätan pacapäcamay wac trönuchru tayayag Diospa naupanchru mana capäcunäpag, jinaman chay Achrcashnuysi cayag mana cunchuchipäcamänanpag” nir.
Jinamansi cay nipäcuntan: “Cananga alisca piñasha cunchuchimänanchi junagmi chraramun. Caytaga manam pisi awantanmanchu” nircayar.
